title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Member Terms — Conversion of Points into Finch Notes
content:
**Rule.** Whenever the points balance of a Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership is at or above the points per note, one block of that many points is converted into one Finch Note of the note value, issued for the reason "points conversion", and this repeats block by block until the balance is below the points per note. Conversion happens within the note issue business days and cannot be requested early or postponed. Each note gets its own note code. Its expiry date is the issue date plus the note validity days of the tier held on the issue date, less one day (the issue date is day 1). Notes are issued only while the membership is active; a suspended membership accrues points without conversion until it is reinstated. Notes are digital, are held in the member's account and cannot be transferred.

The points per note, the note value, the issue time and the note validity of each tier are those of the Finch Note schedule.

## Conversion worked through (hypothetical; 1000 points per note, 10.00 per note)

| Points balance before | Notes issued | Points balance after |
|---|---|---|
| 2350 | 2 notes of 10.00 | 350 |
| 1000 | 1 note of 10.00 | 0 |
| 999 | none | 999 |

## Expiry date worked through (hypothetical)

- Tier held on the issue date: Finch Circle Diamond, validity 120 days. Issue date 1 June (day 1). Expiry date: 1 June plus 120 days less one day, that is 28 September.
- Tier held on the issue date: Finch Circle Member, validity 60 days. Issue date 10 January of a year that is not a leap year (day 1). Expiry date: 10 March.

## Points of judgement

- A member cannot ask for conversion to be postponed to a later month, or brought forward before the balance reaches a full block.
- Points accrued while the membership is suspended stay as points until reinstatement; no note is issued while suspended.
- A note cannot be moved to another member's account.
